definitions.explanation: A small room in an office or building equipped with a sink, a kettle or hot water supply, and sometimes a microwave. Used by staff to make tea, wash cups, and take short breaks.

examples.japanese: {給湯室|きゅうとうしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I made tea in the kitchenette.

examples.japanese: {給湯室|きゅうとうしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{各階|かくかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一|ひと}つずつ→一つずつ：24348_hitotsuzutsu⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is one kitchenette on each floor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼休|ひるやす}み→昼休み：01715_hiruyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{給湯室|きゅうとうしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{雑談|ざつだん}→雑談：06639_zatsudan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日課|にっか}→日課：00317_nikka⟧になっている。
examples.english: Chatting with colleagues in the kitchenette during lunch break has become part of my daily routine.

notes:
USAGE:
{給湯室|きゅうとうしつ} literally means "hot water supply room." It is the standard Japanese term for an office kitchenette or break area with a sink and hot water. In many Japanese offices, it functions as a communal space for making tea and coffee.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {給湯室|きゅうとうしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to make tea in the kitchenette)
- {給湯室|きゅうとうしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to clean the kitchenette)
- {給湯室|きゅうとうしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧ (use of the kitchenette)
